title: An alternating form space on an n-dimensional vector space over any field has an s-dimensional common isotropic subspace or surjects onto all alternating forms on a t-dimensional subspace when n is at least s times t to the fourth power
difficulty: Ordinary prerequisites are finite-dimensional linear algebra, radicals and simultaneous congruence operations over an arbitrary field. The remaining authored construction first obtains a large minimum-degree restriction, then isolates successive alternating pivot pairs in reverse order and performs a tube-fibre induction that confines every collateral change to an unused independent tail. Maintaining that simultaneous independence is a nonroutine new construction above ordinary qualification problems; conservative H1, with all four stages retained.

title: Nonzero multiplicative-function coincidences along coprime positive affine forms have logarithmic density zero when nonunit-modulus primes have divergent reciprocal sum
difficulty: After the precisely stated logarithmic binary-correlation theorem and ordinary pretentious-distance estimates, the remaining argument must create a positive-measure family of archimedean projections, eliminate characters uniformly across powers, extend the associated twists through continuous sumsets and apply a quantitative approximate Cauchy equation. The authored uniform-in-power closing argument is coupled to those constructions and is more substantial than an ordinary qualifying-exam application of Tao's theorem; conservative H1.
